dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん」
帰り支度をしていると、音夢が声をかけてきた。
dialogues.en: When I was getting ready to go home, Nemu talked to me.
dialogues.text: When I was getting ready to go home, Nemu talked to me.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、これからどうなさるんですか？」
ふふふ、と微笑みながら音夢が首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: She asked me with a strange smile on her face.
dialogues.text: She asked me with a strange smile on her face.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだな、明日は試験だし、いっちょ図書室
　で勉強でもしていくか」
dialogues.en:
"Let me see...... I think I'll stop by the library and study
for the test tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"Let me see...... I think I'll stop by the library and study
for the test tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいっ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……だって兄さんが図書室で勉強なんて」
dialogues.en: "......I didn't expect you to be studying in the library."
dialogues.text: "......I didn't expect you to be studying in the library."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、明日は雪だな」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「自分で言ってる」
dialogues.en: "Don't make a fool out of yourself."
dialogues.text: "Don't make a fool out of yourself."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それに、その程度で済めばいいですけど」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ、雷とかか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「槍とか豚」
dialogues.en: "Maybe arrows and pigs will fall from the sky."
dialogues.text: "Maybe arrows and pigs will fall from the sky."

dialogues.jp: 豚？

豚が降ってくる光景を想像していた俺の前で、
音夢が“仕方ない”と軽くため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
As I imagined pigs coming down from the sky, Nemu looked at
me and sighed.
dialogues.text:
As I imagined pigs coming down from the sky, Nemu looked at
me and sighed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「私は先に家の方に戻っていますから。兄さん
　も、勉強頑張って下さいね」
dialogues.en: "I'm going back home now. Good luck with your studying."
dialogues.text: "I'm going back home now. Good luck with your studying."

dialogues.jp:
先ほどとは逆に首を傾げ、裏モード全開の笑み
を浮かべて、音夢が教室を去っていく。
dialogues.en:
Nemu left the classroom with a tilt of her head and a
strange smile.
dialogues.text:
Nemu left the classroom with a tilt of her head and a
strange smile.

dialogues.jp: 「……豚ねぇ」

そんなに珍しがられなくてもなぁ、と頭を｛か／掻｝き
ながら、俺は図書室のある特別教室棟へ向かう。
dialogues.en:
I scratched my head and walked toward the building with the
library in it.
dialogues.text:
I scratched my head and walked toward the building with the
library in it.

dialogues.jp: 「おっ、ここだ、ここ」

図書室なんて滅多に来ないからな。無事に着け
て、なによりなにより。
dialogues.en:
I rarely come to the library. I was glad that I made it here
safely.
dialogues.text:
I rarely come to the library. I was glad that I made it here
safely.

dialogues.jp:
一人でうんうんやっていると、中から見知った
二人が出てきた。
dialogues.en:
When I was standing by the door, I saw two familiar faces
coming out of the room.
dialogues.text:
When I was standing by the door, I saw two familiar faces
coming out of the room.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんにちは、朝倉くん」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩、ども」
珍しく先輩が初めから起きている。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉？　こんな所でなにやってんの？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「フッ……図書室で勉学に｛いそ／勤｝しもうと思ってね」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「冗談」

俺が前髪をフワサッ、としようとするよりも早
く、眞子が俺の言葉を一刀両断する。
dialogues.en: Mako quickly commented as I tried to act arrogant.
dialogues.text: Mako quickly commented as I tried to act arrogant.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺を信じろ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「無理」
またしても、即答っすね。
dialogues.en: Once again, she answered right away.
dialogues.text: Once again, she answered right away.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、そう言わずに信じろ。そうすれば、明
　日はトンカツ食べ放題だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Just...... trust me. If you do, you can have all the pork
chops you want tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"Just...... trust me. If you do, you can have all the pork
chops you want tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「は？　なにそれ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「俺が勉強すると豚が降って来るらしい」
dialogues.en:
"When I study, pigs are supposed to start falling from the
sky."
dialogues.text:
"When I study, pigs are supposed to start falling from the
sky."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」

何の疑いも無く、頷いている……この人は、も
う少し疑うことを知るべきだろう。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai asked me with a pure expression...... She needs
to learn to be more suspicious of others.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai asked me with a pure expression...... She needs
to learn to be more suspicious of others.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「でも、困りました……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……何がです？」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「私達も今、図書室に行ったんですけど、混ん
　でいて座れなかったんですよ……」
dialogues.en:
"We were just in the library, but it was too crowded, and we
couldn't find a seat."
dialogues.text:
"We were just in the library, but it was too crowded, and we
couldn't find a seat."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「バカな！？　俺より勤勉なやつが、そんなに
　居るとは……」
dialogues.en:
"Are you serious? There are that many people who actually
study?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you serious? There are that many people who actually
study?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それって、全人類じゃん」
ズバッ、と今度は真横に叩き切られた。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……私達、これから図書館に行くところ
　なんですけど……ご一緒しませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"Umm...... We're going to the public library now. Would you
like to join us?"
dialogues.text:
"Umm...... We're going to the public library now. Would you
like to join us?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「図書館……ですか？」
仮想傷口を押さえながら呟く。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
俺は図書館の位置を、記憶の深部から引き出す。
dialogues.en: I tried to remember where the public library was located.
dialogues.text: I tried to remember where the public library was located.

dialogues.jp:
それは、俺の帰宅コースから、大きく逸脱した
所にあった。
dialogues.en: It was a long way from my normal route home.
dialogues.text: It was a long way from my normal route home.

dialogues.jp: （……めんどいな）
「いえ、今日は大人しく帰りますので」
dialogues.en: "No thank you. I'll just go home today."
dialogues.text: "No thank you. I'll just go home today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？　残念です」
dialogues.en: "Really? I wish you'd come with us......"
dialogues.text: "Really? I wish you'd come with us......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なに、もう諦めたの？　根性ないわね」
dialogues.en: "Are you giving up already? You're such a loser."
dialogues.text: "Are you giving up already? You're such a loser."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ……じゃ萌先輩、また今度」
dialogues.en: "Leave me alone...... See you later, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Leave me alone...... See you later, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、私達はそろそろ失礼しますね」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃね」

萌先輩はぺこりと頭を下げ、階段を下りていく。
眞子は当然、言葉だけ。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai bowed and went down the stairs with Mako.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai bowed and went down the stairs with Mako.

dialogues.jp: 「俺も帰るか」

トンカツ食べ放題がなくなったのは、いささか
残念だが、なんとなく安心して俺も帰路へとつ
くことにした。
dialogues.en: "I guess I should go home now."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should go home now."

dialogues.jp: ◆槍のち豚◆

図書室でテスト勉強でもしようかと言う俺に、
音夢は明日豚が降るという。まったく……。
dialogues.en:
When I told Nemu that I was going to study in the library,
she said that pigs would fall from the sky tomorrow. Good
grief......
dialogues.text:
When I told Nemu that I was going to study in the library,
she said that pigs would fall from the sky tomorrow. Good
grief......

dialogues.jp:
だが図書室はあいにく満員御礼。図書館行くと
いう萌先輩と眞子に誘われるが、さすがにかっ
たるいので帰る。
dialogues.en:
However, the library was packed with students. Moe-sempai
and Mako asked me to go to the public library, but I decided
to go home.
dialogues.text:
However, the library was packed with students. Moe-sempai
and Mako asked me to go to the public library, but I decided
to go home.

dialogues.jp:
悔やまれるのは、トンカツ食べ放題がなくなっ
たことか。
dialogues.en: I regret the fact that there will be no pork chops tomorrow.
dialogues.text: I regret the fact that there will be no pork chops tomorrow.
